article_title.ru: NVIDIA сменила руководителя, заявив о сохранении планов выпуска продукции
article_title.en: NVIDIA changes leadership while pledging to maintain its product plans
article_title.ja: NVIDIAが経営交代、製品計画の継続方針を示す

caption.ru: Смена руководства NVIDIA сама по себе не определяет судьбу вычислительных платформ, от которых зависят разработчики роботов. Обобщённая редакционная сцена: инженеры подключают и настраивают компьютер. Это не реальная лаборатория NVIDIA, не изображение конкретного продукта и не подтверждение исполнения обещаний совета директоров. На стене — условный учебный плакат о полупроводниках; он не воспроизводит конкретный исторический оригинал.
caption.en: NVIDIA’s leadership change does not by itself establish the future of the computing platforms on which robot developers depend. A generalized editorial scene shows engineers connecting and setting up a computer. It depicts neither an actual NVIDIA laboratory nor a particular product, and does not demonstrate delivery of the board’s commitments. The wall carries a generic educational semiconductor poster, not a reproduction of a specific historical original.
caption.ja: NVIDIAの経営交代だけで、ロボット開発者が依存する計算基盤の行方が決まるわけではない。技術者がコンピューターを接続し、設定する様子を一般化した編集イラスト。実在するNVIDIAの研究室や特定の製品を描いたものではなく、取締役会の約束が果たされたと示す場面でもない。 壁の半導体ポスターは説明用の創作で、特定の歴史的な実物の複製ではない。

alt.ru: Чёрно-белая гравюра: двое азиатских инженеров работают за футуристичным столом с плавно закруглённой столешницей, двумя широкими опорами и общей устойчивой базой. Слева женщина в рабочей куртке подключает сетевой кабель к компьютеру, придерживая корпус другой рукой. Питание подключено через отдельное нижнее гнездо. Справа мужчина в очках и свитере печатает, глядя на повёрнутый от зрителя монитор. У обоих эргономичные кресла. На стене плакат без надписей: полупроводниковая пластина и микросхема.
alt.en: Black-and-white engraving: two East Asian engineers work at a futuristic desk with a rounded top, two broad supports and a stable shared base. At left, a woman in a work jacket connects a network cable to a computer, steadying its housing with her other hand. Power is connected through a separate lower inlet. At right, a man in glasses and a sweater types while looking at a monitor facing away from the viewer. Both have ergonomic chairs. A wordless wall poster depicts a semiconductor wafer and a chip.
alt.ja: 白黒の版画。東アジア系の二人の技術者が、丸みのある天板、二本の幅広い支柱、安定した共通の台座を備えた近未来的な机で働く。左の作業着姿の女性は、片手で筐体を支えながらコンピューターにネットワークケーブルを差す。下の別の接続口には電源ケーブルが付く。右の眼鏡とセーター姿の男性は、こちらに画面を見せないモニターを見てキーボードを操作する。二人は人間工学に配慮した椅子に座る。壁の文字のないポスターには半導体ウエハーとチップが描かれている。

visual_thesis: Корпоративная смена руководства и техническое состояние вычислительной платформы — разные уровни фактов. Один обобщённый эпизод инженерной работы подчёркивает зависимость робототехники от вычислительной инфраструктуры, не утверждая ни остановки продуктов NVIDIA, ни уже доказанной непрерывности их поддержки. Основание — статья nvidia-leadership; сюжеты других статей не используются.
visual_brief:
Edit the supplied black-and-white editorial engraving. Keep exactly the same single scene, two technical specialists actively working on one generic computer system, the closed desktop tower, the woman's network-cable connection and stabilizing hand, its separate plugged-in lower power cable, the man's keyboard action, monitor facing away, professional distance, landscape 16:9 composition, solid physical support, black ink on pure white, confident contours and disciplined moderate crosshatching. This remains an editorial concept for a NVIDIA leadership-change article, not reportage or a particular NVIDIA product.

Make these requested changes:
1. Both people are now naturally depicted as East Asian adults, with individual realistic, attractive faces and ordinary contemporary hairstyles. Woman and man both visibly East Asian, no caricature or exaggerated ethnic features. Keep the woman's focused technical action and practical work jacket. Keep the man's glasses and plain knitted crewneck sweater, focused gaze at his monitor, both hands typing naturally. Preserve harmonious anatomy and calm professional dignity. No romantic gestures.
2. Replace the rustic wooden workbench and traditional chairs with restrained FUTURISTIC ENGINEERING FURNITURE. The desk is a clean, smoothly rounded monolithic white composite or brushed-metal worktop with minimal seams and two broad, visibly connected structural supports anchored on the floor. A broad continuous pedestal base or two sturdy sculpted supports, sensible load path, no floating tabletop, unsupported cantilever, transparent support or decorative spikes. Chairs are ergonomic minimalist molded shells with proper backrests, seats and stable bases; show only what the composition requires. Futurism comes from clean curves and construction, NOT glow, neon, colour, controls or needless gadgets. Keep monitor, keyboard and computer fully supported and within comfortable reach. Cables lie naturally on the desk and pass visibly over an edge or behind objects, never through solid furniture. Preserve every important hand/plug/socket contact.
3. Add ONE modest scientific wall poster in the upper central background, high enough not to overlap faces, hands, computer tower or working action. It lies flat against the wall in correct perspective. It is a wordless educational illustration of semiconductor technology: a simple circular silicon wafer with a restrained grid of small rectangular dies, and one enlarged plain square chip below it. This is a generic invented educational poster, NOT a claimed reproduction of an identifiable historical poster, a real product diagram or a particular NVIDIA device. No readable text, numerals, brand marks, political symbols or complicated pseudo-schematics. Simple thin paper edge, no decorative frame. Secondary scale: the poster must not dominate the workers.

Physical audit: the woman's fingers grip connector housing, plug aligned with socket, other hand presses on solid housing; keyboard fingers touch keys; all monitor/tower furniture supports visibly connected; power plug stays seated in lower inlet; cables separate and plausible. Keep clear silhouettes and light faces/hands. Avoid excessive fine texture, grey wash, colour accents, sepia, logos, pseudo-interface, extra people or tools. Do not introduce a robot or any other story.
